notes.title: Descend into Death of a Wish on March 11th!
notes.content:
Fight your way through a nightmare when [b]Death of a Wish[/b] launches on Steam on [b]March 11th, 2024[/b] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44191615/e1b692854633274df9ec3a630d8142f98e9d1b49.png[/img]

[b]Death of a Wish[/b] is a vicious action-RPG set in a nightmare of horrifying monsters and terrifying people. Master brutal hack-and-slash combat as you rise up against against the cult that raised you. Watch the new trailer by [url=https://www.youtube.com/@CodexEntry]CodexEntry[/url]!

[previewyoutube=AZVI6F7MogM;full][/previewyoutube]

Play as Christian as he unites with new allies and comrades to challenge the oppressive religious order that raised them. By taking down the four Sanctum Faiths: Father, Sister, Cardinal, and Priest, they will upend the order of the world.

[h2]Features:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Challenging, rewarding combat that emphasizes tactical aggression -- achieve high style ranks to reduce ever-escalating corruption
[*] A robust RPG system with powerful perks that allow you to alter the rhythm of combat to fit  your playstyle
[*] Explore a bleak dreamworld where traumas come to life as surreal characters, encounters, and stories
[*]  A chilling soundtrack that blends electronics and live instruments by Nicolo Telesca
[/list]

If you own [b]Lucah: Born of a Dream[/b], you'll receive a 10% discount on [b]Death of a Wish[/b]! Wishlist it now to get notified once it releases to take advantage of this deal! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2302080/Death_of_a_Wish/

notes.title: Update Version 1.5.0 (Spanish Localization & Bug Fixes)
notes.content:
[b]¡LUCAH: BORN OF A DREAM ha sido oficialmente localizado al Español! Golpea, corta y asciende en este RPG de acción acerca de la exploración intrapersonal.[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33232720/4f2520e3df473ba58c93c02a4cd662a3e17c965d.png[/img]

Lucah: Born of a Dream is now available in Spanish, courtesy of translator and localization specialist [url=https://twitter.com/cop_killer_666]Marina Magnolia Venegas[/url]!

Update version 1.5.0 introduces localizations into Lucah: Born of a Dream! When starting the game for the first time, you will be prompted to pick a language:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33232720/0308a78bce91fbc6fe6ca0bef0f9794bb1ef7944.png[/img]

If you already have a save file and wish to change the game language, you can also change the language anytime during game play from the game menu (Select on a gamepad/ESC on keyboard, default controls).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33232720/a5bb7bdc2e5f31c7f573b4062a5365c5409a5c5e.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33232720/91166630979a97dc4f1177f4dc41d29f93c0c176.png[/img]

Localization options will allow us to add new languages to both this game and future games, and we already have another localization project in progress! I'm very excited for more people to have access to this game, and for the option to experience the game again in a new way.

Along with the Spanish localization, update 1.5.0 has a few important fixes:

[olist]
[*] Clearing the Descent now unlocks [b]Turbo[/b] mode for [b]all[/b] save files by default (thank you to speedrunner [b]Durante[/b] for discovering this issue).
[*] Fixed a bug that caused crashes during the [b]Arcade[/b] section, particularly in the [b]Switch[/b] version of the game [b](the Switch patch containing this fix will be out in the near future)[/b]. While this didn't cause crashes in the PC version, this fix should still prevent some unintended behavior when defeating enemies quickly in the Arcade and the Descent.
[*] Fixed a bug that would allow the [b]Serah[/b] boss fight event to occur multiple times.
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the [b]True Final Boss[/b] to become inactive during the final phase of their fight.
[*] Additional minor tweaks and fixes.
[/olist]

I'm working on some exciting new projects for 2021 and beyond, so be on the look out for future updates and announcements! 

Wishing you a safe and wonderful new year,
- colin. ([url=https://twitter.com/melessthanthree]@melessthanthree[/url])

notes.title: LUCAH: THE DESCENT Free Expansion Available NOW! (Update 1.4.0)
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33232720/473070ca49239735131face55410894cfdc508e6.jpg[/img]

Hello all,

It's the one-year anniversary of LUCAH: BORN OF A DREAM's release, and it's been an emotional and rewarding journey for myself and the team since. I have been floored by the kindness and sincerity in those of you who have come to join us, and for that I thank you from the bottom of my heart.

To celebrate LUCAH's first birthday, I am proud to release THE DESCENT, a free, ultra-challenging expansion to LUCAH: BORN OF A DREAM. To access this standalone story, head to this mysterious door at the end of Track 7/the beginning of Track 8, and talk to the cultist beside it - they'll let you in, if you're persistent.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33232720/676ccb49aa113d4f2c34d223c4afabc727952f70.png[/img]

This expansion features a whole new story with new enemies, encounters, a new sacrament, and big secrets to discover...if you can survive it.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33232720/25aaafed2ec0690a4639b6a36a62fb5fb1cbb077.gif[/img]

I look forward to seeing you all take these final steps with me. My time to say good bye to Lucah is soon, but until then, there's much to discover.

Until next time,

- colin. <3

notes.title: The Confirmation Update & Steam Sale
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33232720/5573ff1055004025564c2bc124eb16d7e66b968c.png[/img]

Hi Folks, 

Lucah: Born of a Dream is discounted as part of the Steam Halloween Sale. If you’ve been holding off or had the game wishlisted for a while, now’s the perfect time to experience the game RPG Site described as “a breathtaking adventure filled with well-crafted characterization that doesn't pull any punches”. To commemorate this milestone, check out this incredible piece of promo art by [url=https://twitter.com/save_complete]Bluffy[/url].

We have a major update for you all this week. Today marks the debut of the [b]Confirmation Update[/b], the first out of four major content updates to [i]Lucah: Born of a Dream[/i] that will extend and expand the experience of the game. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33232720/842462f359db0a284eab358bccb80c106bd02b4d.png[/img]

One of the most requested features from the community has been Achievements, and the Confirmation Update adds twenty nine of them. If you’ve played through [i]Lucah: Born of a Dream[/i] once thusfar, the Confirmation Update gives a perfect reason to return to the surreal dreamscape and master the combat and explore narrative branches you might have missed on your first route. If you load an existing save file, achievements will retroactively apply to your account. 

We are also excited to announce that Steam Trading Cards are now supported for Lucah. By playing the game, you will have the chance to earn trading cards that you can craft into customizable rewards for your profile. If you’d like to join the community and connect with other fans, join our [url=https://discord.gg/kndNGvJ]Discord server[/url].

    May the Null Sun have Mercy. 

Kevin

tags.feature: One of the most requested features from the community has been Achievements, and the Confirmation Update adds twenty nine of them.
We are also excited to announce that Steam Trading Cards are now supported for Lucah.

notes.title: Patch Notes - Version 1.1.3
notes.content:
Hi all,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33232720/1fb293d817e597c9347a598180f17c5c54d582ed.png[/img]

Writing to let you know we are up to version 1.1.3 of Lucah: Born of a Dream. The fixes in here are pretty extensive, so I'd recommend updating the game before playing if you have an earlier version.

Fixes include:

- More consistent confirm/cancel input in menus
- Some fixes for when you swap the confirm/cancel buttons
- Fixed "Early Taunt"
- The amount of la you have should always be visible when it's needed (ex. Merchant)
- Minor fixes regarding level design + combat encounters
- Track 4 combat encounters should be less exploitable in ng+ 
- Minor fixes and changes to the credits
- Settings should transfer over correctly from start menu -> new game (I'm not as confident about this one so let me know if it pops up again)
- Revert should be a bit safer to use
- Tweaks to some boss revenge and health values
- Christian animator fixes

This week I'll be working on some slight content updates, as well as a minor sound fix and some more menu polish for keyboard and mouse users. Expect that update to drop either this week or next.

If you've been enjoying the game so far, don't forget to leave us a recommendation letting others know how you feel about the game! Reviews help immensely with our visibility and to help others discover our extremely cool game.

Thanks so much for playing and supporting Lucah, your help means even more than you can know!

- colin (developer, @melessthanthree)

notes.title: Lucah: Born of a Dream is releasing August 21!
notes.content:
Hi all,

We have a new trailer announcing our release date: August 21! That's less than 3 weeks away!!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=DN1A3ebLUPI] TRAILER	[/url]

 This initial release will be everything you helped make possible last year, plus a bit extra (we got New Game + in!!). After the first release, I plan on releasing a few (free) content updates in the coming months, including some extra optional content, the backer-designed content, and of course, the stretch goal extra character! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33232720/e08413389b0fe6f7eb2e96e174126af7633a7c94.png[/img]

We're going to start fulfilling backer rewards for a copy of the game in the coming weeks by sending out Steam keys, so be sure your backer surveys are filled out if you are a Kickstarter backer! If your name or email has changed since filling out your survey, send me a message here or on twitter (@melessthanthree) so I can change that information on my end.

We're almost there; thanks for sticking with us! We could not have created this game without you all.

Many thanks,

- colin. (@melessthanthree)
